items.title: Bal Gangadhar Tilak in Madras, 1917
items.description: English: Indian boy scouts awaiting the arrival of Bal Gangadhar Tilak (the great advocate of Home Rule for India) in the Central Station compound in Madras, 1917.
items.author: Press Agency photographer

items.title: Annie Besant, half-length portrait, seated, facing slightly right
items.description: Annie Besant (1847–1933), who set up the second Home Rule League, in Adyar, in Madras, in September 1916.
items.author: Library of Congress
